verdict.rationale: AWS is a cloud platform rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question here. AWS publishes open-source MCP servers under its official awslabs GitHub organization (aws-docs-50), and a probe confirmed an official MCP server documented there (aws-probe-4). The evidence is only a repository title plus a probe hit, so connection depth is unshown. Missing for 10: documentation of setup and connection steps, which AWS services and tools are exposed, authentication and IAM scoping for agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
